cards.name: Multiline Outline Text Box - Left
cards.summary: Multi-line white Arial Bold text (left aligned) inside an auto-sizing box with an orange 7 px outline and a transparent fill. key-fact callout box in a documentary
multi-line caption or note in a reel

Font size is locked in this template (size edit disabled); resize with Transform 'Scale' instead.
Long paragraphs take a while to type on and fill the frame; keep to 2-4 short lines.
